findings.minimal_fix: Require exactly one weight shard per canonical device (Counter(nd)==1 for every canon) in addition to unique-hash count and tot==mb.
findings.reason: Only unique shard_hash count is compared to device count. Duplicate-device plus missing-device layout (e.g. 2 shards on dev0, 0 on dev3) keeps len(sh)==4, passes weight_dev/peak_cover/reconcile and overstates pooled distribution.

findings.minimal_fix: Require len(devices)==phys and len(canon)==len(devices); duplicate canonical entries must FAIL instead of collapsing.
findings.reason: Duplicate canonical_id entries share nm so phys does not increment and len(canon)==phys still holds. Single role with 2 copies of same GPU yields phys==1 and passes single_phys, hiding duplicate list.

findings.minimal_fix: Add explicit len(ds)==phys check; keep alias-overlap FAIL but also fail duplicate-canonical padding.
findings.reason: Catches distinct-canonical alias collision but not same-canonical duplication, so root/subdevice alias dedup is incomplete.

findings.minimal_fix: Reject extraneous roles and enforce total attempts==3 with roles exactly {single,three,four}; malformed entries => NOT_CHECKED.
findings.reason: Non-dict/missing-role entries ignored and extra roles (e.g. 'two','five') never examined; unbound extra evidence passes silently alongside valid single/three/four.

findings.minimal_fix: Remove default; missing/non-int/negative max_staleness_ns => NOT_CHECKED staleness.
findings.reason: Missing staleness bound silently defaults to 10s and widens acceptance; contract requires explicit fresh source/timestamps bound, not a fallback.
Allocator checked only against attempt while attempt checked against observed, so allocator vs observed can be up to 2*ms and still PASS; fresh-allocator claim allows double window.

findings.minimal_fix: Either allow >=4 with matching peak/shard reconciliation or document scope as exactly-four receipt.
findings.reason: Task states >=4 distinct physical DISCRETE participants for four-card claim; ==4 rejects a valid 5+ GPU pooled receipt as FAIL.

findings.minimal_fix: Document limit: trusted==True is sole authority; no logit-to-cpu-hash binding is performed, so PASS is not measurement authentication.
findings.reason: artifact_source/cpu_reference_hash only checked non-empty; logit cpu values never tied to cpu_reference_hash, so any in-tolerance numbers pass when trusted.

findings.minimal_fix: Keep as-is but scope PASS as schema/logic receipt only; physical backing requires ROOT admission, never string flag alone.
findings.reason: Self-reported backing string cannot prove device-VRAM residency vs CPU/spill/host-staged/shared; advertisement/parity/metadata alone is not backing proof.

findings.minimal_fix: Keep NOT_CHECKED for non-dedicated classes and scope PASS as logic-only; actual peak allocation needs runtime admission.
findings.reason: Allocator class/source/peak numbers are self-reported fields; highwater-minus-reserve proxy, driver delta, or planned budget would still be rejected only if fields omitted, fabricated equal numbers pass.

findings.minimal_fix: Require native_error is None for clean OOM/success; ''/False => NOT_CHECKED or FAIL.
findings.reason: Empty-string/False accepted as no native error, lenient sentinel for controller state that must show no native-error substitute.

findings.minimal_fix: Document 1e-12 as binary-repr guard or require exact fixed-tolerance equality with stated decimal handling.
findings.reason: Undocumented 1e-12 slack widens fixed-tolerance semantics; small but violates no-tolerance-widening without justification.

safety_checks: Source imports only math; GPU-free import holds by inspection, no CUDA/Level-Zero/driver/hardware access.
No source execution, import, tests, tools, or file alteration performed in this audit; static review only.
Candidate is UNTRUSTED until ROOT compile/test/admission; any PASS is schema/logic receipt only, not physical-capacity proof.
Synthetic fixtures validate schema/logic only and cannot authenticate measured resident bytes, peaks, or backing.
THIS audit native child launches 0; authorized maximum-10 Qwen/DeepSeek children not exercised.
Exit mapping PASS 0 / FAIL 1 / NOT_CHECKED 2 preserved; missing authority stays NOT_CHECKED, no CPU/spill/shared/iGPU counted as discrete.
Strict bool/int/float and finite checks present via _i/_n; RMSE<=maxabs and per-logit tol bound CPU refs enforced.
Actual-file tests load CANDIDATE_PATH with no embedded duplicate source and assert FAIL/NOT_CHECKED negatives, not fake PASS.
Shared iGPU arithmetic allowed but discrete==True and form_factor==discrete_gpu required; iGPU cannot satisfy four-discrete count.
No purchasing advice, no tolerance widening (except noted 1e-12), no old-evidence reuse; bounded waits with no uninterruptible-driver cancellation promise.
